label: Calm to light air
description: Smoke may drift, while leaves barely move.

label: Light to gentle breeze
description: You can feel the wind; leaves and small twigs move.

label: Moderate to fresh breeze
description: Dust or loose paper may lift; small branches or trees begin to sway.

label: Strong breeze to near gale
description: Large branches and whole trees move; walking against the wind can be difficult.

label: Storm-force or stronger
description: Trees may be uprooted and structural damage can occur.
